a.title: Ask AgriVoice
a.intro: Ask about crops, diseases, fertilizer, water, pests or schemes. Speak, upload a recording, or type.

a.tr_hint: Fix any mistakes, then press Send.
a.copy_hint: Select the text below and copy it.

a.detect_note: Uses Gnani Prisma v3.0. Your chosen language is still used for the answer.
a.empty: Ask your first question. For example:
a.ex1: My paddy leaves are turning yellow. What should I do?
a.ex2: When should I irrigate my groundnut crop?
a.ex3: What is PM-KISAN and how do I apply?

w.title: Weather
w.not_found: Place not found. Try a nearby town.
w.unavailable: Weather could not be loaded right now. Please try again.
wp.heat: Very hot weather: water early morning or evening, and cover the soil with mulch to keep it moist.
wp.cold: Cold weather: protect young plants and nurseries at night.
wp.rain: Heavy rain expected: make sure water can drain from the field, and delay spraying and fertilizer.
wp.rain_soon: Rain is likely soon: do not spray pesticide or apply fertilizer today.
wp.wind: Strong wind: support tall crops like banana and maize, and do not spray.
wp.humid: High humidity: fungal diseases spread easily. Check leaves often.
wp.dry: Very little rain expected in the coming days: plan your irrigation.
wp.ok: No special weather precautions right now.

he.title: Help
he.q1: How do I ask a question with my voice?
he.a1: Open Ask AgriVoice, press the microphone, speak, then stop. Check the text, correct it if needed, and press Send.
he.q2: Can I use my own language?
he.a2: Yes. Choose your language on any screen. Voice works for: {voice_langs}. Other languages work by typing.
he.a3: No. It is only guidance and can be wrong. For serious problems, contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or agriculture officer.
he.q4: How do I see the weather?
he.a4: Add your state and district in My Farm & Profile.
he.a5: Only you can see them. You can delete them any time in History.
